title: Node announce durable pin/floor store
description: Child 1 of ta0c decomposition (Rust). Build a fail-closed, rollback-resistant durable store for Node Announce trust state, mirroring the gateway pattern (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs GatewayTrustPersistence + GatewayOscoreSenderStore): sealed records keyed by exact pubkey/IID pin (prevent IID-collision trust replacement after restart) and per-origin 16-bit Announce sequence floors in a separate floor root; schnorr48 seal with node persistence key material bound to record domain + key fields; load() fails closed when exactly one of (state, floor) exists or state precedes floor; only (None,None) initializes fresh. Target: rust/lichen-node (new module or lichen-link trust.rs companion), no_std-compatible where feasible (std for storage behind feature like the gateway).
close_reason: Durable sealed pin/floor store implemented in rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs mirroring the gateway GatewayOscoreSenderStore pattern: pubkey/IID pin + per-origin seq floor per record, separate state/floor roots, schnorr48 seal bound to domain+IID+state, fail-closed load matrix (one-side-present, regression, bad seal), accept() enforces pin match and strictly-advancing RFC1982 seq. 10 unit tests pass; no_std default build compiles; clippy clean for new code; fmt applied. 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness) filed 9 beads: vlr1(P0), s6ml, t8ox(P1), vwiq, o80x, 2z16, xn3r(P2), e6wt(P3), wm9z(P4).
